name: The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty
Lust and Lies
summary: By a fateful coincidence, the waif Ruan Feifei enters the Huo family in place of a famed courtesan, assuming the identity of the wealthy heiress Huo Qingwan. For revenge, she navigates between rival factions, while becoming entangled in a love-hate relationship with the domineering marshal Huo Xiu, amidst the bitter feuds of the wealthy.

name: Half-awake
summary: Known for his ruthless demeanor, business tycoon Gu Yixiao has only one forbidden weakness—his secretary, Ye Xingwan. Due to a misunderstanding 15 years ago, he set up schemes to control and torment her. No longer willing to endure, the seemingly gentle Ye Xingwan turns the tables, using herself as bait to engage Gu Yixiao in a love-hate entanglement. In the end, she witnesses Gu Yixiao's repentance and the dawn of redemption, but whether her heart can truly find peace and happiness remains uncertain.

name: Böhmi brutzelt
summary: Based loosely on Biolek's "Alfredissimo", Jan Böhmermann invites one celebrity guest each to his studio to cook, eat and chat together. Each guest chooses their own dish and Böhmermann adds a second one.

name: A Farmer's Fortune
summary: After a sudden fall, food blogger He Qingqing finds herself transported to a pastoral ancient world. She embarks on an inspiring journey—paying off debts through entrepreneurship, finding true love by a marriage and raising an adorable child—as she forges her own path to success. Along the way, she builds a thriving career and develops a deep, mutual affection with Fu Qinghuai. Just as her life seems complete with professional fulfillment, love, and family, she faces an impossible choice: to stay or return to her own time.

name: Beyond Immortals
summary: Ancient myths descend upon the world. High above, the ruined celestial court hangs suspended in the sky, where gods shuffle forward like the walking dead, numb, hollow, and lifeless. As humanity receives the "blessing" of these immortals and stands on the brink of assimilation, a defiant few always rise. They stand their ground and hold fast to the truth of who they are.

name: alfredissimo! Kochen mit Bio
summary: Cooking program with Alfred Biolek, who invites a celebrity guest to each show, talks to them and cooks.

name: The Empress Dowager On A Second Spring
summary: After a traumatic birth leaves her in a coma, Jiang Rong wakes up as the Empress Dowager, with a newborn son. Amidst the scandal of a widow giving birth, she must conceal a deadly secret: the father's identity. To survive and uncover the truth, she navigates a dangerous game with three potential fathers, sparking a mix of romance, comedy, and unexpected revelations.

name: Dragon King's Decree
summary: Feng Zhilou, a mistreated illegitimate daughter, refuses to bow to fate. Despite the scorn around her, she dreams of one day fighting alongside the noble Dragon Clan. Meanwhile, Crown Prince Chu Moshang of the Dragon Clan is destined to marry the Holy Maiden in order to unite forces against the demon race. However, he rejects a union formed for duty and believing true strength should not be bound by tradition or political alliances. When these two defiant souls cross paths, fate takes an unexpected turn. Together, they break societal norms, overcome countless trials, empower each other, and ultimately change the course of destiny.

name: Die Hausmeisterin
summary: Martha Haslbeck is a woman in her early 50s, has a 23-year-old daughter and is divorcing her husband Josef after 28 years of marriage. As a janitor she wears smock aprons and likes to wear blue when she goes out. She has the typical perm, and a beer doesn't leave her cold either. Martha Haslbeck has never left her Munich neighborhood of Haidhausen. But she is a heroine in her apartment building. She simply copes with everything. Whether it's a clogged toilet, an escaped cat or her flatmates' tarnished married life - Martha has a solution for everything.

previousepisode.name: Da glaub i, haben wir was falsch gemacht

name: Happy Endings with Bruno
summary: Happy Endings with Bruno, an all-new original series starring RuPaul's Drag Race Pit Crew member and long-time masseur Bruno Alcantara. Special guests lay down on his table for a full body massage interwoven with intimate and emotional conversations which answer the question: "What does my Happy Ending look like?" Combining the soothing elements of massage ASMR with thoughtful and often vulnerable interviews, Happy Endings with Bruno offers viewers a rare glimpse into the personal journeys of its guests.

name: Long Planned Love
summary: When spoiled heiress Jian Cheng discovers her fiancé's betrayal, she breaks off the engagement in fury and enter a flash marriage with his younger uncle, Zhou Tingyan. What begins as a contract marriage born of a "life-saving debt" slowly transforms into a journey of redemption and true love, set against tangled family ties and ruthless business rivalries. Under Zhou Tingyan's protection, Jian Cheng uncovers the truth behind her high school kidnapping and grows from a reckless, headstrong girl into a composed and independent woman. For Zhou Tingyan, however, this marriage was never just about gratitude. It is the culmination of years of secret devotion and careful waiting. From a calculated bond of repayment to a genuine love story, theirs is a destined meeting of two hearts racing toward each other.

name: Lock Her
summary: On the massacre night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Qin Shiyue, the sole survivor of Qin family, is taken in by Marshal Dai Shiyao. To uncover the truth behind her father's wrongful accusation, she navigates a dangerous game between two brothers—Sheng, who shifts from ruthless possession to deep love, and Dai Shiyao, whose suspicion turns to passion. As war reignites, the trio defies fate: Sheng abandons violence for love, Dai Shiyao sacrifices love for duty, and Qin Shiyue finally finds both truth and rebirth amidst the bloodshed.

name: The Mission Is To Return The Pearls
summary: During the Eastern Han, Hepu's Southern Pearls were valuable, and a gambling culture around them flourished. Li Ling, known as the "Pearl Prince," is ruined by a Magistrate who rigs one of these pearl gambles. Forced to become a pawn in manipulating pearl prices, Li Ling meets a tragic end as the scapegoat. After death, he is reborn moments before his downfall, awakening the supernatural ability to see through and sense oysters. Armed with the memories of his past life, Li Ling gambles without fail, embarking on a path of revenge and a legendary quest to return the pearls as decreed by fate.

name: Dr Ann's Secret Lives
summary: From dense rainforests to remote coastal regions, each episode offers a rare and intimate look at one animal. On the Great Barrier Reef, QLD, Dr Ann comes face-to face with a heavily pregnant bull shark, and in the Pilbara, WA, she goes fishing for deadly, mysterious sea snakes. In the steamy heart of Borneo's jungle Dr Ann looks for wild orangutans; and in the Dampier Archipelago, WA, she meets three species of turtle. In Moreton Bay, QLD, Dr Ann helps catch a dugong for an onboard health check, and along the edge of the Kinabatangan River in Borneo, she hunts for one of the weirdest mammals on the planet, the scaly, labrador-sized pangolin.

name: The Time of Rebirth
summary: Trapped in a time loop for 100,000 years, Lin Yue relived the same day endlessly, until an accidental act of saving the young saintess of the Forgetful Immortal Sect finally shattered the cycle. Now free, Lin Yue embarks on an adventure across the Hongmeng Continent, armed with eons of accumulated wisdom. But the foes he could never defeat in 100,000 years are also stirring in the shadows of this world...

name: 3000 Whys of Blue Cat
summary: The protagonist of the show is Blue Cat, a curious and optimistic cat who is always eager to explore different parts of the world. His friends include a smart and cunning fox named Feifei, a naughty and adventurous mouse named Taoqi and many other animals. As Blue Cat and his friends go on an adventure and encounter problems, the series provides answers to science-related questions posed by Blue Cat.

name: Nela mała reporterka
summary: Follow the inspiring travels of Nela, a young adventurer who explores diverse locations around the globe, sharing her discoveries and experiences in engaging and educational reports for young viewers.

name: The Best People with Nicolle Wallace
summary: Who are The Best People? They're the most magnetic and engaging people in the room; the ones who know how to get that extra something out of every collaboration, connection, and endeavor. These are people who are the best at what they do and know how to bring out the best in others. Now, in an era of social and political upheaval, The Best People share lessons that we can all use. Listen as Nicolle Wallace seeks varied perspectives on how to keep reaching for truth, decency, and connection.

previousepisode.name: Lt. Gen. Mark Hertling Knows Leadership… And When It's Lacking

name: Okami no Heya
summary:
The spin-off on Watashitachi wa Douka Shiteiru.

The story will shed some light on the inner workings of Kyoko, the Landlady of Kougetsuan, and mother to Tsubaki, as she tries to take down Nao. Kyoko is a woman of the high society and the worst kind of enemy one could ever wish upon their foes. She has spent her life raising her only son, Tsubaki, to be the successor of Kougetsuan. We learn more about her dark schemes as we enter The Landlady's Room. It may even be possible to make sense of the disturbing hymns she sings and unravel the mystery behind the murder of the Landlord 15 years ago.

name: First Copy
summary: In the heart of Mumbai during the 1990s, 'Arif,' a notorious and desperately romantic figure, rises to infamy as the kingpin of film piracy. As he weaves an intricate web of distribution, his audacious exploits attract the attention of law enforcement, Bollywood celebrities, and the criminal underworld, leading to a thrilling cat-and-mouse chase.

name: Till Tonight
summary: Till Reiners invites you to his first late-night show, which combines political satire and modern stand-up comedy.

name: falsch, aber anders lustig
summary: Laugh until the tears come: In this unique comedy show, it's not who's right that counts, but who has the best sense of humor. Two teams of two comedians compete in a witty battle for the most absurd answers to crazy questions. The comedy highlight is hosted by Moritz Neumeier - known for his biting humor and spot-on punchlines. "Wrong, but funny in a different way" guarantees entertainment at the highest level.

previousepisode.name: Hazel und Fabian in der Ehe-Krise

name: Comedy Clash
summary: The Comedy Clash describes itself as "Germany's toughest stand-up competition in the world". The series shows the performances of hopeful comedy talents and follows their progress. Only the best make it to the annual final. In 2024, SWR will turn the "Comedy Clash" into an interactive live stand-up comedy event on the Twitch streaming platform. Viewers will be able to vote for their favorite comedians in seven monthly livestreams. The Twitch livestream is hosted by sports reporter and soccer commentator Robby Hunke. He is alternately supported by the streaming stars Starlet Nova, Donnie O'Sullivan, Reeze and Jasmin Gnu. They provide trenchant comedy analysis, respond to opinions and reactions from the Twitch community and give viewers the opportunity to influence the show in the stream.

name: A Caverna Encantada
summary: The plot tells the story of Anna, daughter of Paulo, a missionary doctor. The two live together in the north of Minas Gerais. Paulo receives a call to a dangerous mission and, unfortunately, Anna will not be able to accompany him. The father leaves his daughter at a boarding school in the interior of São Paulo, where the girl will live with very different children. Paulo promises to return on his daughter's birthday, but mysteriously, he doesn't return.

name: Love Phobia
summary: A VR dating CEO who hates love meets a romance-clueless writer. As they clash between AI-driven passion and analog emotions, a sweet yet messy story of healing and unexpected connection unfolds.

name: Colosseum: Rise and Fall
summary: New discoveries and cutting-edge research reveal the history of Rome's Colosseum and its intricate relationship with the empire that created it. Combining the latest archaeological evidence from the Colosseum itself, with clues from ancient sites in Europe and North Africa, we explore the building's extraordinary archaeological and cultural history, and its role in Rome's rise and fall.

name: Merci professeur !
summary: A chronicle of the French language, its curiosities, current events and accents.

name: Destination francophonie
summary: A journey to francophone countries around the world! In each country, we meet francophones who tell us about their culture, their way of life and what concerns them in French. The program also highlights projects that contribute to the survival of French, a living, dynamic and constantly evolving language, at the local level.

name: Aligned Reverence
summary: Orphaned girl Su Jinyuan trusted the wrong person and fled her marriage, only to bring disaster upon herself. When she returned, she was horrified to find the entire Xiao family, her benefactors wiped out. To atone for her sins, her fate becomes entwined with Xie Yunyan, the Xiao family's adopted son who had taken his brother's place at the wedding. Together, they struggle to survive in desperate circumstances, break free from the shackles of the world, tear their enemies apart, and carve out a blazing, blood-stained love that defies destiny itself.

name: Dragon Flyz
summary: In a future decimated by war, only a small band of humans survive. The radiation from the war has created many new species, including huge, semi-intelligent dragons and evil mutants. The only source of power is the volcanic stone amber, but locating it is a constant problem, with the mutants and other species laying claim to their finds. Without the amber, their floating city cannot stay afloat. Protecting the city is an elite group using the dragons as transport, the Dragon Flyz.

name: Aşk ve Gurur
summary: The Köksoylars live in an ancestral mansion as a wealthy and rooted family. With three daughters, the family is sinking and on the verge of losing everything. In a state of great panic, they contemplate how to escape the impending disaster when Tolga enters their lives like a savior. He is the heir to a wealthy and established family. If one of the daughters marries him, life will continue as it used to, affluent and secure. The idea is considered for the eldest daughter, Mercan, to marry him. However, Mercan rebels against this imposition, finding Tolga excessively arrogant and frivolous. Despite Tolga and Mercan being attracted to each other, Mercan's high pride and Tolga's spoiled attitude build thick walls between them. However, unlike Mercan, there is someone who desires him passionately- the middle daughter, Gül. Tolga shifts his focus from Mercan to Gül. As they drift towards marriage, Tolga's heart remains with Mercan. Mercan, too, has fallen in love with him. The girls' mother insists on a quick marriage because Tolga will rescue them from the financial crisis. However, Tolga is just as submerged as them and desires this marriage for his own salvation.

name: Mary Kills People
summary: Based on a Canadian series, this dark comedy is the story of a doctor who is illegally helping terminally ill patients end their life, and a detective who is investigating these illegal activities.

previousepisode.name: There are definitely patients who need euthanasia.

name: Tian Yu
summary: A millennium ago, the Five Monarchs guarded the land of the Xia Dynasty with magical artifacts. Later, the leader of the Dragon Clan, Zu Long, assisted humanity by establishing the Yun Chui Empire. The Empire faces the Tranquil Ocean where the Xi and Black Water Clans have defended it throughout a peaceful millennium. Now, the waves are surging from below and chaos will rise once again.

name: S Line
summary:
Suddenly red lines appear above people's head. These red lines connect people who have had sex relations. Due to this, embarrassing or secret sides of people are revealed. People call these red lines "S Line."

Han Ji-Wook (Lee Soo-Hyuk) is a detective with an attractive appearance and free spirit. He chases after the truth of the S Line. Kyu-Jin (Lee Da-Hee) is a high school teacher with unique charm. Hyun-Hob (Arin) is a high school student. She has been able to see the red lines since she was born.

name: The Revenge Club
summary: Six strangers meet at a Divorce Support Group and form an alliance, pooling their various skills to become a group of audacious revengers. But the gang starts to fall apart when their pranks develop into a succession of ruthless murders.

name: Veliaht
summary: Due to his worsening health, Zülfikar Karslı begins to lose his former influence at the bus terminal. Meanwhile, all eyes are on his son Zafer, who is rumored to be returning soon from abroad. At the same time, Timur, a roaming repairman struggling under the weight of debts left by his father, crosses paths with this secret-laden family. Unknowingly, he steps into a fate he never imagined—as the successor to Zülfikar: Zafer Karslı. From that moment on, nothing will ever be the same for Zülfikar's children: Kudret, Derya, Cennet, Zafer, and Zafer's wife Reyhan.

name: Bears' Lair
summary: Bears' Lair is an exciting new series that offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to aspiring Indigenous entrepreneurs. Follow their journeys as they pitch their best ideas to four business experts and face off in a collaborative competition!

name: Luc le milliardaire?
summary: Starting from nothing, raised in a public housing project by a mother on social assistance, Luc Poirier built an empire valued at nearly 1 billion dollars from a few bags of candy. An extraordinary life story... Imagine this rapid social ascent seen through the eyes of the person who best knows how to put words to money stories: Pierre-Yves McSween.

name: Busu ni Hanataba wo.
summary: Hana Tabata is used to being invisible. With a plain appearance and a pessimistic view of romance, she's convinced that love and cute things are out of her reach. But everything changes when Yousuke Ueno, the handsome and kind boy from her class, suddenly takes an interest in her. As Hana navigates awkward moments and unexpected attention, she begins to question her own worth and what it truly means to be seen. A heartfelt, offbeat high school romcom that proves love isn't just for the beautiful.

name: Las Muertas
summary: Based on Jorge Ibargüengoitia's novel, the series tells how the Baladro sisters built a brothel empire and became merciless killers in 1960s Mexico.

name: TechTalk
summary: Discover flying taxis, robots for the elderly, firefighting drones, 3D holographic surgery & much more! Explore a world of technology & innovation that you never dreamed existed! Multiple Award-Winning Series TechTalk, takes you to see the hottest start-ups & upcoming entrepreneurs from across the globe. Checkout 50+ wow-factor new technologies that are transforming our planet for the better.

previousepisode.name: Futuristic Zappers, Robot Washers & Brain Gaming

name: Murder on the Doorstep: The Killer Clown
summary:
Murder on the Doorstep: The Killer Clown tells the story of Marlene Warren, a young wife and mother who was shot in the face on the doorstep of her Florida home by a clown bearing balloons and flowers.

Behind her brutal murder, which was witnessed by her 21-year-old son and his friends, lay a web of love, betrayal and deceit. Amid rumours of infidelity, her husband emerged as the prime suspect, but Michael Warren had a cast-iron alibi and was never charged.

The crime remained unsolved for nearly three decades until, in a surprise twist, Michael's alleged mistress and subsequent second wife, Sheila Keen, was arrested for the crime. Although maintaining her innocence, Sheila agreed to plead guilty to second-degree murder to avoid a potential life sentence.

name: Hate the Player: The Ben Johnson Story
summary: Hate the Player: The Ben Johnson Story is Canadian sprinter Johnson's definitely-not-biased account of the doping controversy that rocked the 1988 Olympics when he tested positive for banned steroid use, going from hero to zero in 9.79 seconds in what some called "The Dirtiest Race in History". The series takes a revealing and satirical look at the events surrounding the legendary race and the scandal behind the scandal.

name: CNN's The Fourth in America
summary: CNN's The Fourth in America, a must-see musical experience featuring star-studded performances and firework shows from across the country, will celebrate the 249th anniversary of the United States' independence.

name: Mein großer, dicker, peinlicher Verlobter
summary:
In this show, Mareike, a dentistry student from Kiel, was introduced to "Gunnar Janßen". Her task during the show was to convince her parents that she wanted to marry him. From her point of view, "Gunnar" had the same task towards his own parents. If they succeeded, they would receive a large sum of money.

In reality, however, "Gunnar" was the actor Tetje Mierendorf, who had been hired by Sat.1 to make Mareike's task as difficult as possible. To do so, he ignored many taboos, such as a complete lack of table manners, rudeness and clumsiness. His family and friends were also impersonated by actors, all of whom deliberately displayed behavior that was shocking to Mareike and her family.

Following the show, Mareike received a fee of 500,000 euros. "Gunnar" only explained to her and her family one minute before the arranged marriage that everything had been staged and that he did not normally behave like this. The entire show was accompanied and commented on by presenter Jessica Witte-Winter.

name: Fukushuu no Miboujin
summary: Suzuki Mitsu is a talented contract engineer working for an IT company, but it wasn't their benefits package that attracted her. She's working for the company that drove her late husband to suicide, and she won't rest until she exacts her revenge on each and every person responsible.

name: Time Raiders
summary: Antique shop owner Wu Xie stumbles upon a mysterious silk manuscript. His uncle, Wu Sanxing, discovers an enigmatic map hidden within it. To find the missing owner of the manuscript, Wu Sanxing forms an expedition with Wu Xie, Panzi, Zhang Qiling, and Da Kui. They venture into the location marked on the map. During their quest, Wu Xie meets Wang Pangzi, another explorer. Facing life-threatening challenges and attacks by mysterious creatures, the team relies on teamwork, wit, and courage to survive. Deep underground, they uncover a bronze fish with snake-scale patterns, a discovery that unexpectedly reveals Wu Sanxing's buried past. After a meeting with a mysterious woman named A Ning, Wu Sanxing suddenly vanishes. To uncover the truth and find his missing uncle, Wu Xie and his companions embark on a new journey...

name: About Love
summary: The drama tells the story of Li Xiaoxi, a cautious and serious woman when it comes to love, who unexpectedly meets Xiaobei. Their chance encounter blossoms into a romantic relationship. Xiaobei's loyalty and unwavering support give Li Xiaoxi the strength to gradually overcome her insecurities about love. In turn, with Li Xiaoxi's companionship and acceptance, Xiaobei heals from past emotional wounds and learns to let go and cherish the present. As they navigate their relationship, facing challenges together, both grow and ultimately find a sincere and lasting love.

name: Inseparable
summary: Under the peaceful life of noodle shop owner Han Dong and his wife Lin Meiyue lies a turbulent past. Lin was once "Li Rongzhen" in night clubs and was blackmailed and exposed by her former "friend" Ling. Meanwhile, the secret that Han has buried for twenty years is uncovered due to a mysterious revenge plot. The relentless pressure from Han's old friend Sun Haitao plunges the couple into an invisible web of intrigue—Han's past cowardice led his high school classmate Zhao Xiaoqi into the darkest period of her life. The alliance between Lin and her former close friend Mei also reveals a shocking secret from the past that points directly at the all-powerful Sun family. The couple goes from passive defense to a desperate counterattack, joining hands to defend their family and exposing the Suns' crimes. When the dust settles, Han and Lin are imprisoned for their past helplessness and present disproportionate retaliation.

name: Great Gift
summary: Could the perfect murder be possible? A pathologist discovers a deadly bacteria called "Gift", and a fierce power struggle and mysterious serial murders take place... A fierce survival game begins!

name: A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai
summary: Takeru Kamishiro is a normal guy with an ordinary office job but finds himself summoned to another world. Takeru starts his new life in "Madeus," a world with swords and magic, fully equipped with multiple skills! Not only does he have enhanced physical and amazing magic abilities, but also the power to "search" for valuable items. With the cheat skills he's been provided, Takeru starts his new adventure in the new isekai!!

name: Erde an Zukunft
summary: Future magazine for children and young people that sets out in search of an answer to the question of what should be different, better, more beautiful or new in the future. In each program, presenter Felix Seibert-Daiker embarks on a monothematic journey to where the future is emerging or can already be experienced in the here and now.

previousepisode.name: Wassermangel – gibt es genug Wasser in der Zukunft?

name: The Proper Way to Write Love
summary: "I wanted to see him make this kind of face." I was a gloomy nerd in high school, and at that time I was entwined with Washizawa Natsuo – my dark past. Now, a few years later, we have reunited and Natsuo asked me out. This is my chance. We'll go out, then I'll break up with him, leaving him in tatters!

previousepisode.name: The Proper Way to Write Love

name: NHK Newsline
summary: foreign news program aired on NHK's international broadcasting service NHK World TV

previousepisode.name: Special Coverage - 11 Years: Beyond the Triple Disaster Part 2

name: Geheimsache Doping
summary: The series investigates the background to doping cases in various sports.

name: A Panorama of Rivers and Mountains
summary: Shanghai, 1933. A secret meeting of Communist underground members is raided before it even begins, leaving half of the 12 attendees arrested. Among them are a senior intelligence officer carrying vital secrets and a dangerous traitor hiding in plain sight. Chen Qianli, newly returned from the north, is sent to Shanghai to uncover the traitor and complete another top-secret mission. As old friends, former mentors, long-lost brothers and memories of a past love resurface, he must cut through layers of deception and protect the truth with unwavering faith.

name: Hanayome to Papa
summary: Uzaki Aiko a new 20-year-old daddy's girl works in the apparel company of her dreams. Her father, Kentaro, loves his daughter excessively to the point that he compels her to follow his house rules: 7:00pm curfew, no socialising with the opposite sex. Nevertheless, she falls in love with her colleague, played by Taguchi, and begins a mission to "graduate" from her father.

name: Club der dinosaurier
summary: Best friends Ben and Janni are so-called late bloomers and are constantly overlooked by women. Therefore, they decide they urgently need to become more "manly" – immediately. They contact school dealer Corny, who is supposed to procure them an illegal testosterone supplement from the dark web, which will become their holy grail on the path to "manhood." And indeed, overnight, they develop muscles, become more self-confident, and even manage to outdo the class bully Rick, who also has his eye on the class crush Suki.

name: Reset - Wie weit willst du gehen?
summary: The seemingly perfect life of the self-confident, successful presenter Flo suddenly falls apart: she finds her teenage daughter Luna dead in her room - suicide. When Flo finds out about the Plan B agency, which can send its clients back in time in order to avoid mistakes and set a different course in life, she doesn't hesitate to take the second chance.

name: Summertide
summary: Love, loss, rivalry, and relationship woes. Follows the lives of the Field family in beautiful Simon's Town as they tackle trials and tribulations. Watch as secrets come to the surface and their lives intertwine with other residents of the town.

name: After Resigning, Secretary Song Went Crazy
Justice on Trial
summary: Judge Judy Sheindlin puts the American justice system on trial in a true crime high-stakes courtroom drama, as she and her expert legal team recreate the trials from notorious cases where following the letter of the law did not necessarily feel "just." Season 1 spans from the 1925 Scopes Monkey Trial to a case in which the convicted killer is currently on Death Row.

previousepisode.name: Scopes Monkey Trial (State of TN v. Scopes)

name: Trinity
summary: A heroic female naval officer becomes involved with the outwardly charismatic secretary of defense, only to discover he may be at the heart of a dangerous conspiracy.

name: The Ferry Man 10th Anniversary
summary: In the city of Huanhai, Xia Dongqing and Ya run the 444 Convenience Store, a shop that bridges day and night. They are joined by a new partner—the mysterious "Night Watcher," who bears an uncanny resemblance to the missing Zhao Li—and together they safeguard the fragile balance between the human world and the spirit realm. As the trio resolves a series of supernatural incidents hidden within everyday life, an unexpected event shatters the city's tranquility. Under the ominous glow of a blood-red moon, they must confront a sinister conspiracy and fight to restore reality. Peace eventually returns to Huanhai City, and the 444 Convenience Store remains open for business, but along the ancient stone-paved streets, new mysteries are already beginning to emerge.

name: Critical: Between Life and Death
summary:
In London, a major trauma happens every 60 minutes, and for the NHS, each call is a race against time. Critical: Between Life and Death gets inside the minds of the dedicated trauma teams that hold our lives in their hands when the worst happens.

From the makers of the award-winning 24 Hours in A&E and with exclusive access, 40 cameras are embedded for 21 days across the entire London Major Trauma System. The documentary series goes over the shoulder and under the scalpel to reveal not only the life-saving interventions but also the personal, emotional, and sometimes traumatic reasons that inspire those on the NHS frontline to do a job where every second counts.

name: Uglymug, Epicfighter
summary: His looks are -255, touching girls causes him pain, and sexual acts will literally tear him apart. Just what can our ex-salesman Shigeru get in the other world in exchange for such inconveniences...? This is an epic tale of one very ugly, but ridiculously strong man!

name: Hitmakers
summary: In this glitzy reality series, under-the-radar talents head to high-stakes songwriting camps in Nashville, the Bahamas and Cabo to pen the next big hit.

name: Overdo
summary: "Overdo" tells the story of Murong Qingyi, the youngest son of a warlord family in Republican-era Shanghai, who suffers abuse from his adoptive father after being switched at birth. When he escapes as a young man, he is saved by Ren Susu, but his involvement brings disaster upon her family, causing its downfall. Years later, the two reunite and secretly develop feelings for each other, yet Ren Susu resolutely fakes her death and disappears to save others, leaving Murong Qingyi to sink into the pain of losing love. Three years later, Ren Susu returns, only to become Murong Qingyi's future sister-in-law. Now, one carries deep resentment from betrayal, while the other hides an indescribable pain. Between suspicion and struggle, their love and hatred become intertwined. As misunderstandings are gradually cleared and their love reignites, a national crisis arrives. With the determination to face death in their fight against enemies, where will the fate of Murong Qingyi and Ren Susu lead?

name: Jinrou Game: Lost Eden
summary:
10 high school students who are in the same class get caught and forced to play The Werewolf game, where they have to kill each others to survive.

This is set in the same universe as all the other "Jinrou Game" movies that came before and after, but feature different students. Only movie that has more direct ties to this drama is "Jinrou Game: Inferno" (2018). All the movies were initially theatrical releases.

name: Hidden Love For You
summary: Duan Jiaxu and Sang Zhi became acquainted due to an incident at Sang Zhi's school that required parental involvement. Since then, Duan Jiaxu has treated Sang Zhi like his own younger sister with affection. As Duan Jiaxu graduated from university and the two were separated by distance, misunderstandings caused their relationship to grow distant. It wasn't until Sang Zhi, now an adult, successfully got into the same city's university as Duan Jiaxu that they were reunited. Through their increasingly close interactions, Sang Zhi gradually discovered the source of Duan Jiaxu's long-standing stress. She wanted to protect this kind-hearted...

name: 119 Emergency Call
summary: Yuki Kasuhara, a command officer in Yokohama's Fire Department, handles 119 emergency calls, balancing high-pressure crises and workplace challenges. Known for her quick thinking, she often defies norms by visiting accident scenes, sparking friction within the team.

previousepisode.name: We're Not Fighting Anymore ????️ A Gift Warmer Than the Hot Packs from i-dle's SBNs ????

name: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensaitachi no Renai Zunousen - Mini
summary:
A prestigious private high school has students who rank academically at the top of the nation. The school's student council president is Miyuki Shirogane, and their student council vice-president is Kaguya Shinomiya. They are attracted to each other but do not confess their feelings for each other due to their stubborn pride. About half a year has passed since they have kept their feelings private. Now, Miyuki Shirogane and Kaguya Shinomiya think the person who confesses first will be the loser. They both think of ways to make the other person confess first.

This mini-series ties to live-action theatrical movie and was developed along with the second theatrical movie. It doesn't hold an actual full story, but rather bonus story with certain moments, the main story is told in the movies. Unlike anime which follows manga, this story takes liberty and has changes in the content so it isn't the same thing re-told in live-action format, but the base premise is the same.

name: In Flight
summary: Jo Conran is a single mum working as a flight attendant. Her son is serving a fifteen-year sentence in a Bulgarian prison for a murder he swears he did not commit. Jo is approached by a gang who know all about her son and is blackmailed into using her job to smuggle drugs. She soon finds herself pulled into a murky underworld of corrupt cops and hired killers, forced to carry out their orders with no escape in sight. However, no matter how far Jo finds herself from her old life, her mission remains the same, to keep her son alive.

name: Girl Taken
summary: The story follows twin sisters Lily and Abby, whose lives are shattered when Lily is abducted from their quiet rural English town by beloved local teacher Rick Hansen. After years of abuse in captivity, Lily escapes – only to discover that freedom brings its own challenges. The world she longed to return to has moved on without her. As Abby, Lily and their mother Eve struggle to rebuild their family, they must confront the lasting damage and the terrifying reality that Rick is still out there, determined to control the narrative and evade justice.

name: Nukitashi the Animation
summary:
Seiran Island. Even here in paradise, there are those who work in the shadows to bring it down...

United, these misfits stand side by side as the secret society NLNS. As their founder and head honcho, I, Junnosuke Tachibana, won't stop until we've crushed this crazy law once and for all!

I've even found a benefactor in this crusty old rich guy, name unknown... He's hooked us up with a secret base and a buttload of cash already. In return, he wants us to find someone and "protect her at all costs." Apparently, she holds the key to our mission's success...? In which case, there's only one thing to do: locate this mystery girl. And all while keeping the SHO off our scent, too...

Make no mistake! I'll stop that law in its tracks, just wait and see!

name: Basique, le concert
summary: Meeting with a singer or a band and retransmission of one of their concerts.

name: Milky Subway: The Galactic Limited Express
summary: Arrested for reckless space driving, super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina are sentenced to clean the Milky Subway—an old interplanetary train. Easy enough, right? Wrong. When the train suddenly takes off, they are thrown into a high-speed space-train spectacle packed with chaos, no plans, and zero strategy. Just pure momentum!

name: Bad Girl
summary: Yuu Yuutani, a first-year high school student with sharp eyes, large piercings, and flashy two-tone hair, is not a well-known bad girl who everyone makes way for. She is actually a very good girl at heart, and her mind is always full of thoughts of the school's Madonna, Atori Mizutori. Wanting to attract the attention of the disciplinary committee chairman Atori, Yuu decides to quit being an honor student and become a "bad delinquent!" A school comedy depicting the struggles of a slightly foolish self-proclaimed delinquent is about to begin!

previousepisode.name: Goodbye / I'll Give You All of Them! / The Ultimate Bad Girl

name: Няня Оксана
summary: Oksana from Krasnodar Region arrives to her fiance in Moscow, but he leaves her. Oksana remains to conquer the capital and accidentally gets a job as a nanny in the family of a widowed restaurateur with three children.

name: Amy Bradley Is Missing
summary: This true-crime series investigates the 1998 disappearance of a 23-year-old woman from a Caribbean cruise and her family's tireless search for answers.

name: Сломанная стрела
summary:
Broken Arrow (2025)

Riot police officer Maksim recently lost his daughter. This event had a devastating effect on his psychological state. After another attack of aggression, Maksim's boss forces him to go on vacation. At this moment, a call comes from an old friend of Egor, who invites Maksim to spend a vacation in Sochi. Fresh air and sunshine should have put the riot policeman's thoughts in order, but everything is happening quite the opposite. A series of events leads him to the village of gold miners, where a priceless artifact was recently discovered.

name: Brennpunkt: Psyk
summary: The number of beds has halved in 20 years. Now seriously mentally ill people will be helped at home. Does it work? Join us in a world of mania, psychosis – and hope.

name: Chef Grudge Match
summary: Boxing champion Laila Ali is stepping into the ring once again, this time to host Food Network's Chef Grudge Match, a single round, winner-take-all culinary battle where elite chefs come to settle long standing disputes and bitter rivalries.  From employees who have been wronged by their boss to restaurateurs defending their livelihoods from copycats, competing culinary pros put their favorite knives, and egos, on the line in a bid to put old scores to bed. Each episode features two head-to-head battles where resident judge Jet Tila welcomes a guest judge to help determine who walks out with $10,000 cash, the losing chef's most coveted knife and bragging rights for life.

name: A Fazenda
summary: The concept of the show is such that puts a group of celebrities (or subcelebrities) on a farm where they stay together for a period of three months. When the contestants are on the farm, they have to work like a normal farmer, like doing agriculture and raising animals for example. During their stay on the farm in regular periods, one of the contestants is evicted from the farm by way of a public telephone/SMS/internet vote. This process is continued until a final contestant is chosen and then he wins the prize of R$ 2 millions.

name: Tamanho Família
summary: Márcio Garcia gathers celebrities and their families in games that reveal routines, stories and intimacy details that only those who are from home know.

name: Blanks
summary: Blanks follows a serial dater whose life is turned upside down when he learns his biological clock is running out, just as he meets the woman of his dreams, who isn't ready to settle down yet.

name: Meet Iron Man and his Awesome Friends
summary: A batch of animated shorts to introduce audiences to the stories and main characters featured in Iron Man and his Awesome Friends, as well as the newly announced Captain America, Black Panther and Iron Spider, whom the Iron Friends call on when they need a helpful hand in taking on super baddies or just want to have a fun adventure.

name: Ein kurzes Leben lang
summary: Stories from the everyday life of the Kern family in Hanover. Father Rudi and mother Hilde are the two heads of the family, and Grandma has to comment on everything.

name: 7/7: Homegrown Terror
summary: A full and intimate look into the full scale of one of the worst terrorist attacks to ever occur on British soil.

name: Crime Scene Cleaners
summary:
Crime Scene Cleaners follows some of the hardest-working crime scene cleaning companies in Britain and the USA that help people get their lives back to normal after the most traumatic events imaginable.

From dealing with the aftermath of murder, drug dens and arson attacks, crime scene cleaners are part hazardous material clean-up crews and part therapists, on-call 24/7 to some of the most horrific crime scenes and sometimes putting their own lives in danger – and they're about to reveal all in this captivating new series.

name: Equals
summary: A UEFA documentary series about women's football, featuring interviews with some of the sport's leading stars.

name: Bi Xia, Chen De Zhen Xin Cang Bu Zhu
Kesenai "Watashi": TVer Original Story
summary: This is the prequel to Kesenai "Watashi" drama and is meant to be watched after the main drama to avoid spoilers. It adds background info on the main characters and depicts the story of Jin and Shoko 10 years before the start of the revenge.

name: Kurokawa Morio, Arbeit Sagashitemasu!
summary:
Kurokawa Morio and his friends have conversations that lead to Morio recalling his past part-time jobs and deepens his love for Yukiko. An unexpected connection between Morio and Yukiko is revealed.

This is a side story for Koi Desu!: Yankee-kun to Hakujou Girl drama.

name: Koi wa Deep ni Benkyō‑Chū!
summary: Koi wa Deep ni Benkyō‑Chū! (恋はDeepに勉強中！) is a Hulu-original spin-off of Koi wa Deep ni. It shifts focus from the main romance to the third brother, Eitarō Hasuda (played by Watanabe Keisuke), exploring his trials and curiosities about love and relationships. It's a lighthearted, comedic 3‑episode series, diving into Eitarō's humorous attempts at understanding romance—like planning surprise gifts and giving advice to his colleagues.

name: Maintenant ou jamais : FC Montfermeil
summary: Follow the teen soccer players in the notorious Parisian suburb of Montfermeil in a critical season that will determine their future.

name: Súper Sara
summary: A fascinating look at the life of trailblazing Hollywood icon Sara Montiel, widely considered Spain's first international star.

name: Breaking4: Faith Kipyegon vs. the 4-Minute Mile
summary: What does it take to become the first woman to run a mile in under four minutes? Follow Faith Kipyegon, Olympic gold medalist and world record holder, as she prepares to push the limits of human potential and break a barrier previously thought impossible on June 26th in Paris.

previousepisode.name: Breaking4: Faith Kipyegon vs. The 4-Minute Mile Part 2

name: El desafío
summary: El desafío is a contest in which weekly a group of celebrities face difficult tests in order to be the best in the game. It is presented by Roberto Leal and produced by Atresmedia in collaboration with 7 y acción.

name: Nighties
summary: The series focuses on hotel heiress Millie and her best friend Adriana. Together, the two try by any means necessary to keep their beloved princely palace afloat. Each episode of the initially eight-part series chronicles a night shift of the hotel crew until dawn. During this shift, bedless guests are sometimes brought to concierge Charles's reception at 3 a.m., whose very special requests make the team sweat. The hotel bar is an emotional refuge for many of the characters of the night. Bartender Rafael works there, and with his unwavering good humor, he can find something positive in even the most bizarre and darkest night. Head chef Franca, on the other hand, is firmly convinced that a real Hollywood star has checked into the aging, traditional hotel.

name: Hip Hop Was Born Here
summary: Hip Hop Was Born Here will chart the creation, evolution and ongoing legacy of Hip Hop not just as a genre but as a culture. Taking viewers on a journey through Hip Hop history – meeting OGs and future icons, visiting the neighborhoods, studios and places that fostered early styles as well as watching beloved artists analyze their favorite tracks.

name: Married Women's Lips Taste Like A Can of Chuhai
summary:
Tsuyoshi, a 22-year-old third-year university student, spends his days juggling classes and his food delivery job, with a can of strong chuuhai always within reach. Living alone in a small apartment, his mundane routine takes an unexpected turn when he finds himself entangled with Yui Koriyama, a married woman he has admired since childhood. What begins as an innocent connection soon escalates into something far more intimate, blurring the lines between longing, desire, and morality.

Set against a backdrop of quiet nights and stolen moments, this risqué yet comedic tale explores the thrill and complications of an illicit romance—where every encounter is both intoxicating and dangerous.

previousepisode.name: The Flavor of a Quiet Former Rebel, the Barbershop Owner's Lips

name: 9: Ruler's Crown
summary: Shiromitsukawa. It is a town with no special characteristics other than being a school town. The town has been trying hard to attract tourists, but none of their efforts have been successful. However, it has attracted public attention in an unexpected way. Kakeru Niimiis a reliable young man who tends to be blunt, but has a strong sense of responsibility and drive. He is a kind character who, despite what he says, puts the people around him first. He leads a peaceful life as a normal student, but when a sacred object enshrined at the White Snake Shrine is damaged, his daily life changes. In the shadows, there are boys and girls who have awakened to their unusual abilities. They were supposed to be ordinary students living in an ordinary town with nothing special about it. But they are caught up in the strange destiny that the aliens bring about....

name: Viudas Negras: P*tas y Chorras
summary: Pilar Gamboa and Malena Pichot star as two former friends who, when younger, seduced men to rob them. Years later, the past returns with high heels and blackmail, forcing them to reunite, even though they can't stand each other anymore.

name: España directo
summary: España directo (ED) was a current affairs magazine with multiple live connections broadcast and dealt with current affairs such as events, festivals, culture, curiosities, gastronomy and paid great attention to the rural world

name: Españoles en el mundo
summary:
A program that approaches destinations around the world through Spaniards who have decided to settle in another country. These ‘'new emigrants'' offer their particular point of view about the country that has welcomed them and explain their anecdotes about their lives there.

Españoles en el mundo has become one of RTVE's longest-running programs. During more than 11 years of broadcasting and more than 300 programs, reporters and cameramen have visited more than 150 countries and more than 1000 cities, with nearly five million kilometers traveled.

name: The Savage, Noble Death Of Babs Dionne
summary: The crime-thriller centers on Babs Dionne, a proud Franco-American, doting grandmother, and vicious crime matriarch, who rules her small town of Waterville, Maine, with an iron fist. She controls the flow of drugs into Little Canada with the help of her loyal lieutenants, girlfriends since they were teenagers, and her eldest daughter, Lori, a Marine vet struggling with addiction. When a drug kingpin discovers that his numbers are down in the upper northeast, he sends a malevolent force, known only as The Man, to investigate. At the same time, Babs's youngest daughter, Sis, has gone missing, which doesn't seem at all like a coincidence. In twenty-four hours, Sis will be found dead, and the whole town will seek shelter from Babs's wrath.

name: Teach me, Touch me
summary: Kanthi, a wealthy 34-year-old man, meets Gear, a 4th-year student, in a VIP club room. Gear wants to learn how to be intimate, but Kanthi refuses to teach him because he's not attracted to Gear's innocence. Gear is determined to learn, one way or another.

name: Attack on London: Hunting the 7/7 Bombers
summary: Insider accounts and never-seen-before footage tell the story of the 7/7 bombings on London's transport network in 2005 — and its explosive aftermath.

name: Be My (Soul)Mate
summary: Po left his home to live the university life as an engineering student as he had dreamed of. But in the end, he ended up sharing a room with Mhee, a famous judo athlete from the Faculty of Sports Science, who often has problems with his beautiful girlfriend. They take care of each other as friends without meddling in each other's love life. Until the day Mhee becomes single again, the closeness, the bond, and the passionate desire finally begin to surface.

previousepisode.name: Jiwoo store OPEN I met the Chuukkumi and went to Harulala

name: Bürgeranwalt
summary: Three people's lawyers represent the interests of citizens. They make up the majority of the program with two new cases per issue. In addition, patient advocates, ombudsmen of all kinds and interest groups also have a platform.

name: To Catch a Stalker
summary:
Zara McDermott will be exploring the impact of stalking. She will be meeting and spending time with those currently being subjected to this behaviour, witnessing how stalking affects everyday lives and following the process when victims report to police and navigate the justice system.

According to a 2023 study conducted by The Suzy Lamplugh Trust, 1 in 5 young people in the UK have experienced stalking or harassment, with 1 in 10 being stalked online. The crime is evolving in the digital world and repeated unwanted contact takes many forms; from tracking and online hacking to turning up uninvited to where the victim is.

In this series filmed over 10 months, Zara will witness the psychological, physical, social and practical impacts of stalking on those who have been targeted. She will also spend time with a police force to understand how stalking reports are handled and why the conviction rates remain low.

name: Last Night Out
summary:
Last Night Out reveals the chilling stories of the final night of fun for those whose evenings end in tragedy. We meet the under 35s who go out to have a good time but a terrible turn in events leads to their murders.

This UK series uses intimate, down-the-lens interviews with family members, friends, and key figures from the investigation team to tell the stories of these tragic deaths. Blending CCTV footage, social media posts and home movies, each episode forensically pieces together the narrative of their last night out.

name: Can't Sell, Must Sell
summary: From woeful wallpaper to dingy digs and clashing colour schemes, Stuart and Scarlette Douglas transform unsellable houses into market-ready homes.

name: Абдукция
summary: Two feuding classmates—the young and reckless conspiracy theorist Danil and the popular, handsome hockey team captain Sergey—are confronted with mystical phenomena and conspiracies in the small town of Amurgrad in the Far East. The boys must join forces to fight the evil spirits, save their friends, the school, the town, and uncover the villains behind it all. But little do they know that the mystery they are about to face extends far beyond the borders of their small town...

name: Heist Brothers
summary: Heist Brothers follows three distant frog brothers who reunite at their father's funeral and learn they can only inherit his fortune if they work together to rob a bank.

name: 99 – Wer schlägt sie alle?
summary: 100 candidates have to prove their talent in a total of 99 rounds to ultimately win the prize money of 99,000 euros in the grand duel. On the way there, the candidates have to face a mixture of skill, athleticism and cleverness: This includes popping a champagne cork as far as possible, playing tug-of-war against each other, unrolling toilet paper as quickly as possible, melting a block of ice or assigning songs to the right decade. One candidate is eliminated after each round.

previousepisode.name: Die 15 besten Kandidat:innen Deutschlands stehen im Finale!

name: Colegas
summary: Colegas is a series produced by Hill Valley, RTVE's digital content platform, premiered on February 13, 2018 and has six chapters. It tells the story of Manu Feijóo, an actor who was very famous in the late 90s and who wants to be a star again. To do so, he will try to reunite the actors of the series in which he triumphed for a reunion. The series is a dramedy that plays with reality and fiction, since the main characters play actors who worked in a series for teenagers in the 90s, something that many of them did: Manuel Feijóo (Compañeros, Tres son multitud), Julián González (Compañeros, Farmacia de guardia), Marta Solaz (Al salir de clase), Daniel Huarte (Al salir de clase), Lara de Miguel (Compañeros, Los mundos de Yupi), Rafael Reaño (Al salir de clase).

name: Edward Lee's Country Cook
summary: Edward Lee and his three friends set out on a culinary journey to find the taste of their grandmother's cooking! They travel around the country, taste seasonal winter ingredients, and reinterpret the recipes of country grandmothers. Will Edward Lee's country cooking be recognized by K-grandmas?

previousepisode.name: Eddie's Last Dance To Finish The 15-Day Journey

name: The Defects
summary: ‘The Defects' is an action thriller depicting the desperate survival and revenge of children who barely survived on the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

name: Marry My Husband Japan
summary: Misa has been a supporting character all her life, blindly trusting her best friend and husband. When she discovers their affair, the betrayal results in her death. Waking up ten years in the past, Misa vows to become the main character of her own story. She plans to ruin her betrayers by making them marry each other, but after meeting her director at work, starts to consider who she truly is.

name: El gran salto
summary: A story of the fall into hell after achieving glory for Olympic champion Gervasio Deferr, narrated in two time periods: the past, with the different Olympic Games Gervasio won, which will take us back in time: Sydney, Athens, and Beijing. And, on the other hand, the present, focusing on the days it will take him to visit his mother, who suffered a heart attack while hospitalized. A crucial event that will undoubtedly shape the athlete's destiny for the rest of his life.

name: BigBakShow
summary: After graduating from university in the Netherlands, Nagy Norbi returns to his home village of Bakra. With the help of Ott Zoli, he monitors the village with cameras and uploads it to the internet. The residents soon find out and a scandal breaks out, but the mayor sees potential in it.

name: Warm Props
summary: Caught between set life and home life, Charlie Flogim is thrust back to her hometown of Broome where she is forced to deal with a chaotic film shoot and face the one person she vowed never to see again.

name: Alistair McGowan's Big Impression
summary: Alistair McGowan takes a satirical look at the rich and famous.

name: The Big Impression
summary: A comedy sketch show with impressions from Alistair McGowan and Ronni Ancona.

name: Supercruising: Life at Sea
summary: Supercruising: Life at Sea goes behind the scenes on two luxury cruise ships as they travel across oceans carrying holidaymakers enjoying weeks of sun and sea, and takes a look at life below deck, seeing exactly what it takes to operate a passenger vessel around the clock.

name: Naked and Afraid: Apocalypse
summary: For the first time ever, 12 battle-tested survivalists take on a scorched, apocalyptic wasteland where they must scavenge ruins to survive in Naked and Afraid: Apocalypse. In locations long abandoned by humans, the survivalists face the franchise's toughest challenge yet as they endure extreme heat and drought as well as unpredictable lions, elephants, black mambas and more without food, water and clothing. Four teams are dropped into forgotten corners of South Africa – spanning a ghost town, a vehicle junkyard, a cemetery, and even a mine shaft – where they must scavenge the wreckage for resources. In a franchise-first, survivalists will not be extracted but must escape this wasteland and find their way back to civilization at the end of the challenge. All the while, they must also battle relentless threats from apex predators, endure punishing heat and navigate constant dangers from rusted metal and broken glass.

name: Demon's Ascension
summary: What happens when an outlaw teenager who grows up evil steps into the world of immortalism? Immortals and demons, life and death are not in the hands of heaven. Let's watch him swim upstream and become a legend in a world where people and demons stand side by side, and where demons and ghosts run rampant.

name: Away We Go
summary: George Carlin does humorous monologues and joins Greco and Rich and guests in comedy sketches.

name: Maybe Koi ga Kikoeru
summary: Momoi Tsubomi nearly gives up on her dream of becoming a voice actress when she encounters an inspiring, mysterious voice. This voice gives her the courage and hope to pursue her dream once more. Tsubomi learns that the owner of the voice she fell in love with is somewhere in the voice actor academy she is in, and she begins to search for the owner.

name: Dead Ahead
summary: A high-powered Māori lawyer accidentally unleashes her chaotic tūpuna (ancestors), forcing the living and the dead to navigate their shared legacy.

name: Minami-kun no Koibito
summary: What would you do if you were suddenly only 16 cm tall? What would you do if your loved one was suddenly only 16 cm tall? A best selling sentimental love story is dramatized for the second time! Everything started when a high school couple, Chiyomi and Minami had a mysterious and ominous fortune cookie at a Chinese restaurant? If you stay close to him, he will become great, and the two of you will be together for a long time. However, when the two of you drift apart, a horrible thing will happen?. Just as the prophecy, on the very day when Minami decided to leave Chiyomi, a magical curse struck Chiyomi. Believe it or not, it shrunk her into a size of merely 16 cm tall! What would happen when a tender boyfriend and a miniaturized girlfriend secretly start living together?

name: Minami-kun no Koibito
summary: What would you do if your girlfriend shrank overnight reaching the size of a Barbie doll? This is the incredible story of Minami and his girlfriend Chiyomi. After this bad luck, the two teenagers see their lives turned upside down. Minami must now take care of his miniature girlfriend. He designs clothes, builds a small house to her size, takes her to the bathroom and prepares her mini-meals, but how long can this situation last? Not easy for Chiyomi to become a living toy when she is going through puberty and his hormones titillate her!

name: Minami-kun ga Koibito!?
summary: Chiyomi is a high school girl, who was born and raised in a retro Showa-era shopping district in Shonan. She is a member of the basketball club and has a kind personality that stays cheerful despite her somewhat complicated family structure. She and Minami-kun, also known as Minami Hiroyuki, a basketball star from her hometown of Shonan, have been like siblings since childhood, and they are happily in a relationship. However, one day, he suddenly becomes 15 cm in size and fits in the palm of her hand. Chiyomi begins living with him in his now tiny body.

name: DollHouse
summary: You've seen her dominate South Central Baddies, stir the pot on Deja Vu, and keep it real on Greek Life. Now Joce is taking center stage as the host of the hottest new reality series, where bold personalities and big drama all live under one roof. Expect raw emotions, shocking twists, alliances, betrayals, and unfiltered vibes every episode. This is reality TV like you've never seen before!

name: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened
summary: Diddy on Trial: As It Happened takes you inside the criminal trial of Sean "Diddy" Combs, one of the most salacious and hotly anticipated courtroom showdowns in decades. Watch bombshell moments and heart wrenching testimony unfold in real time through meticulous actor reenactments sourced each week from courtroom transcripts. Prosecutors allege the music icon and business mogul engaged in a dark underworld of sex trafficking and prostitution. Combs denies all accusations, maintaining his innocence. Join host Sunny Hostin as she breaks it all down with a rotating roster of legal and pop culture experts, giving you a front row seat to this high-stakes legal battle.

name: The Silk Kingdom
summary: In the Silk Kingdom, fate takes a dark turn on the birth of King Noor Al-Din's second son when the treacherous Golden Uncle kills the king and hunts his heirs. Loyal servant Radwan flees with princes Shams Al-Din and Jalal Al-Din, but they are separated. Shams grows up as a slave soldier, while Jalal survives among outlaws. When they reunite, loyalty and betrayal collide in a battle for power.

name: Ingatlanvadászok
summary: The show features prominent real estate experts competing to find the best properties. In this exciting championship, the "real estate gurus" not only search for the best deals available on the market, but also have to convince applicants that the property they are presenting is the best choice for them. They collect points throughout the week, and at the end of the week, the real estate agent who earns the most points wins the grand prize of 3 million forints.

name: Lead Male Character Search
summary: Oh Seol-Rem was the top student in her grade year at her high school. She got addicted to an online game and failed to enter a university. She is now studying to take her university entrance exam after graduating from high school. She met a male character Tarakexcali in the online game and fell in love with Tarakexcali. She never met him in real life and didn't know anything about him except that he attends Ganghan University. They even promised to marry, but one day, he suddenly disappeared from the online game. She unplugs her computer and studies hard. Finally, Oh Seol-Rem enters Ganghan University where the male character Tarakexcali is attending in real life. She looks around for Tarakexcali.

name: Evict My Kid
summary: Two fed-up families take on a 30-day eviction process to finally push their adult children out of the nest - but can they really go through with it?

name: Инкассаторы
summary: Vitya and Serega are collector partners who have been transporting money for a long time, but every now and then something goes wrong. Once again, when the car is attacked by robbers, the guys manage to fight back. They accidentally find out that this robbery was organized by their boss, and in order to take revenge on him, they decide on a desperate move: to rob themselves.

name: Secretly Loving You
summary: Heiress He Lingfei, who once lived extravagantly, abruptly severed ties with her college boyfriend after her family went bankrupt. Unbeknownst to her, Lu Yichen was actually an abandoned heir of a wealthy family. After being cast out, he clawed his way back and transformed into a cold-hearted CEO. Years later, they reunite at a banquet where He Lingfei, now a fallen heiress, is busy serving her fiancé. Lu Yichen's eyes blaze with love and resentment: When you left me without a word back then, did you ever think about the man you discarded?

name: Jia Xi Zhen Zuo Hou Ta Yong Shi Suo Ai
Two Years Later
summary:
Two Years Later is an eight-part romantic dramedy set in a post-pandemic world, following thirty-somethings Emily and Ryan whose brief, daily flirtations on their work commute aboard a bus are abruptly cut off by COVID-19.

Two years later, they reconnect unexpectedly, and Ryan impulsively proposes they go on eight dates to decide if they're meant to be married. Together, they navigate personal revelations, unexpected family drama, professional upheavals, and their contrasting worldview - all while discovering genuine intimacy.

name: Shaking Down The Thunder
summary:
Shaking Down The Thunder takes an intimate look at the Sydney Swans' journey to break the longest Premiership drought in AFL history, as they chase the 2005 flag.

Under the guidance of new wave coach Paul Roos, the beleaguered "Bloods" adopted a new ethos of leadership, brotherhood, commitment and empowerment which resulted in a new brand of football, one that at times raised eyebrows with critics.

Lead by a rotating group of captains including Barry Hall, and starring Michael O'Loughlin, Brett Kirk and young guns Adam Goodes, Jude Bolton and Leo Barry, the team would finally take to the hallowed turf at the MCG under blue skies for the AFL Grand Final against West Coast in front of 91,828 passionate fans.

name: De Verraders Halloween
summary: In this special Halloween edition full of adventure, manipulation, lies and deceit, celebrities compete against their fellow candidates for a large silver treasure. They know what they are getting into, but can they survive this slasher?

name: Tiny Time Travel
summary: Tiny Time Travel is a series of funny and fast-paced live-action shorts. Tyler, an 11-year-old inventor, and Tony, his outgoing best friend, use their time machine to go back in time a tiny bit (sometimes just a few minutes or hours) to solve problems in their neighborhood. Problems like stopping a friend from spoiling a movie, or giving a customer a re-do after an ordering mistake at a restaurant. Even though Tony and Tyler can only time travel a tiny bit, they always manage to help their friends and neighbors just in time. The series aims to help kids ages 5-8 learn social language skills, like understanding nonverbal communication, taking others' perspectives into account, and resolving miscommunication.

name: Êta Mundo Melhor!
summary: Candinho and his faithful companion, Policarpo, are back for new adventures in the big city. However, his son's disappearance brings new suffering to him, who continues to believe that "everything bad that happens in life is for the better!".

name: The Dark
summary:
When the body of a young man is found eerily staged in the idyllic Scottish wilderness, detective Monica Kennedy fears this is just the beginning of a terrifying campaign that will strike the heart of a rural community.

As paranoia rises, suspicions and secrets are forced into the light, and the locals start to realise that there is a serial killer hidden amongst them. With her experience of dealing with the darkest of humanity Monica Kennedy quickly becomes entangled in a heightened game of cat and mouse with a cunning killer. Only she can stop this monster before he claims any more victims.

But when her own history creeps up on her, she begins to lose trust in her own judgement. Will it be her own actions that are the biggest risk to herself and her family?

name: Blind Date
summary:
The ultimate dating series Blind Date is back - bigger, better, and bolder than ever.

The new series will begin in a secret Blind Date location, where contestants must choose between three potential suitors, hidden from view behind the legendary Blind Date wall, the only thing standing between them and their potential true love just metres away. With a host of unique, innovative and head-turning format twists, our daters will see if forever love can truly grow as they spend the summer living together but potential new partners are always lurking behind the wall...

name: Погоня
summary: Moscow is a city where speed decides a lot. No one is waiting for anyone here. To achieve something, you need to be constantly on the move here. This defines the concept of the show. In each episode, 15 new participants challenge Moscow and its speed. Some of them have already achieved something here (stars), some are just at the beginning of their journey (ordinary people), but they are all on equal terms, and the rules are the same for everyone - you are a fugitive, and hunters are following you. If you can escape, you'll take a large sum. If you get caught, the game is over. Here, everyone decides what to do: unite or be a loner. Try to hide or go ahead.

name: Yoru ga Dorehodo Kurakutemo
summary: Michinari Shiga works as a deputy-editor for weekly magazine Shukan Jiryu, whose sales have risen due to scoops on numerous scandals. He lives the life of a journalist with integrity, until his own university-aged son, murders a couple, then himself. Instead of chasing after scandals, Shiga now finds himself at the centre of one. His situation is now desperate, as fellow journalists hound him, he's demoted to a monthly magazine and his relationship with his wife is quickly deteriorating. But Shiga is determined to expose the truth behind his son's case.

name: Otpisani
summary: Otpisani is a 1974 Yugoslav television series set in Nazi-occupied Belgrade during World War II. It follows a group of young Partisan resistance fighters who carry out covert operations against the German forces and their collaborators. Known for its mix of action, suspense, and patriotic themes, the series became a cultural classic in Yugoslavia.

name: Mysterious Places With Stacy Keach
summary: Mysterious Places with Stacy Keach is a documentary series that explores the world's most intriguing lost cities, bizarre formations, and sacred sites. The series, hosted by Stacy Keach, investigates locations like the Mayan Yucatan, Loch Ness, and Tombstone, delving into legends surrounding King Arthur and more. It features original footage filmed on location throughout the world.

name: I'm Glad My Mom Died
summary: A heartbreaking and hilarious recounting of Jennette McCurdy's struggles as a former child actor while dealing with her overbearing, domineering mother. The dramedy will center on the codependent relationship between an 18-year-old actress in a hit kid's show, and her narcissistic mother who relishes in her identity as a starlet's mother.

name: Scrambled Up
summary: In Scrambled Up, four contestants solve jumbled-up words and phrases that unscramble before their eyes. As the tiles unscramble, the clues get easier. The first player to buzz in with the right answer has a shot at walking away with the $10,000 grand prize.

name: What's in the Box
summary: In this game show hosted by Neil Patrick Harris, players answer trivia to win spectacular hidden prizes — but can they keep them from the competition?

name: Live Up to Your Youth
summary: In 1990s Beijing, a small inn bears witness to the lives of a group of young men and women who have come from all corners of the country, to chase their dreams in the city. Xu Shengli, obsessed with scriptwriting, never gives up despite constant rejection. Singer Zhuang Zhuang, yearning to perform on prestigious stages, can only make a living through commercial gigs. Shen Ranran, hoping to play leading roles, faces opportunities and tough choices in the flashy entertainment industry. Talented cellist Tao Liangliang plays under overpasses, pursuing his musical dreams. Guo Zongbao, a background actor and an artist at heart, juggles odd jobs in order to treat his wife and children's illnesses. Painter Cao Ye, full of avant-garde ideas, struggles in a world that does not understand him. They work tirelessly for their dreams, yet reality is always cruel and unyielding. As the new millennium arrives, some continue to persevere while others are forced to give up, but the flame of art never dies in their hearts.

name: Raul Seixas: Eu Sou
summary: Raul Seixas abandons his career as a music producer to become a singer, mixing rock with baião. He adopts a radical style and falls into addictions, but becomes an icon of Brazilian rock.

name: The Brief with Jim Sciutto
summary: The best of CNN's reporting from correspondents across the world, to guide global audiences through the fast-paced news cycle with insight, analysis and hard-hitting interviews.

name: Baked With Love: Holiday
summary: In Baked with Love: Holiday, 10 talented pairs of home bakers face off in a warm-hearted, family-recipe bake-off.  They will infuse their heritage, personal stories, and cherished family recipes into classic bakes with a twist and serve their dishes to a panel of expert judges.  In the end, one pair will be crowned the Christmas Baking Champions and win the ultimate prize of $50,000!

name: Teenage Boss: Next Level
summary:
From deciding what's for dinner to planning family outings (and maybe ven a cheeky splurge), 10 new teens are about to find out what it really takes to run the show. Emma Watkins is back to cheer them on, offer advice and provide the occasional reality check. 

The teens are not just managing the household budget; they're also saving for their own ambitious goals – from a state-of-the-art drone, to funding a home recording studio or buying their first car. With Emma's guidance they'll face real-life financial challenges teaching both themselves and their parents about money management and independence.

name: Random Rings
summary: In Random Rings, your favorite Disney characters surprise random people by calling them at work! Sometimes embarrassing, always entertaining, these funny phone calls will keep you hanging on every word!

name: Sana's fridge interview
summary: Genius idol Sana's first time being a host in her life! Wanna know about super cute Sana's skill as an interviewer
